description: Stop what you are doing. Prerequisite: you are on a lot with an active avatar (an action queue exists, possibly empty). Effect: by default, every queued and currently-running interaction is cancelled — the engine processes each cancel at the next safe animation break so your Sim may finish a sub-animation before coming to rest. With action_uid set, only that single queue entry is cancelled; useful when you want to abort a long-running interaction without clearing the queue behind it. Cost: whatever progress you made on an interrupted interaction is lost (e.g. Sleep cancelled mid-way does not credit full Energy gain); other Sims observing you see your action_queue clear within one perception tick. The wire cannot distinguish 'cancel current' from 'clear queue' in a single PDU — both are VMNetInteractionCancelCmd with an ActionUID, so clearing the queue requires one cancel per visible entry (what the stock UIInteractionQueue does). We do that locally as the default.

args.name: action_uid
args.description: ushort UID of a specific queued interaction (from perception.avatar.action_queue[].uid). Omit to cancel every queued/running action the bot can see locally.
